notes.title: Updated May 2017
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

this is the start of a series of regular updates to polish the game ready for release!

This update adds a resolution display option which we expect to resolve all the odd resolution and GUI placement issues.

Further news regarding future updates will be released soon!

Fly safe!

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

let me begin by apologizing for the long delay between updates. To explain, I am a solo developer and recently had some real life events that needed my full attention.

I am currently working on several projects, and Damage Control is one of them. I appreciate all the comments and reviews - even the negative ones - as a learning opportunity to show me where I need to improve.

Expect further updates fixing bugs and addressing the issues you gave raised in the next few months,

Thank you again for your time and your patience.

Kind regards

Ross Edgar.

notes.title: Updated 7 Apr 2016
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

A new build has been uploaded to address a few issues

- 2 crash bugs [details in the known issue topic in the forum]
- added GUI icons to represent what your engineers are currently carrying

.. there will be larger updates adding features and content but these were pressing issues affecting gameplay and have been deployed urgently.

If there are any questions or comments please do let us know here, on the forum, via our website or our twitter.

Best Regards

Ross Edgar.

notes.title: Damage Control - Now Available!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

we are pleased to announce that Damage Control is now available to purchase via Steam Early Access.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/450020

We'd like to thank everyone who has supported us!

Now we need to get back to work again! :)

Best regards and thank you for reading,

Ross Edgar.

notes.title: Press Access Keys
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

just a small note, if you are a member of the gaming press (Youtuber, writer, streamer, etc) and would like a press key prior to release, please contact us at:

http://www.highlandgaming.com/contact.html

We'd be grateful if you could tell us who you are with a link to your material and we will get back in touch ASAP.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Regards

Ross Edgar.
